package extest // import "example.com/gp/extest"

Package extest has its examples in an external test package.

FUNCTIONS

func Add(a, b int) int
    Add adds two numbers.


TYPES

type T struct{}
    T is a type.

func (T) M()
    M is a method.


EXAMPLES

    Example
        fmt.Println("package")

        // Output:
        // package
    ExampleAdd
        fmt.Println(extest.Add(1, 2))

        // Output:
        // 3
    ExampleT_M
        extest.T{}.M()
